mantras.title: Kashi Vishwanathashtakam (verse 1)
mantras.textOriginal:
गङ्गातरंगरमणीयजटाकलापं
गौरीनिरन्तरविभूषितवामभागम् ।
नारायणप्रियमनंगमदापहारं
वाराणसीपुरपतिं भज विश्वनाथम् ॥
mantras.transliteration:
gaṅgātaraṃgaramaṇīyajaṭākalāpaṃ
gaurīnirantaravibhūṣitavāmabhāgam |
nārāyaṇapriyamanaṃgamadāpahāraṃ
vārāṇasīpurapatiṃ bhaja viśvanātham ||
mantras.meaning: Worship Viśvanātha, lord of the city of Vārāṇasī — whose mass of matted hair is lovely with the Gaṅgā's waves, whose left side is ever adorned by Gaurī, beloved of Nārāyaṇa, destroyer of the pride of Kāma.
